Re-pinned the dogfood binary to lambo-4c6fc93 (branch lambo-for-mooshik @ 4c6fc93, clean tree, LAMBO_GIT_SHA set, features store-sqlite,embed-candle-metal,embed-bge). Provisioned the sqlite store with the new binary, repointed the launchd unit dev.lambo.dogfood from lambo-21e4cf8, restarted, and verified: lease holder http-shared-writer, ledger heartbeat git_sha=4c6fc93, graph intact (702 nodes / 554 concepts). Config unchanged: sqlite + candle BGE-M3 on Metal. Added the operator start/stop script ~/Documents/work/scripts/lambo-dogfood.sh (start|stop|restart|status|log) and verified a full stop/start cycle releases and reacquires the lease. [Resource] (score 7.27)

Register-discipline technique that paid off twice in J2 round 2: when a stale claim is corrected, also check the claims of every constant the corrected sentence now cites. Rewriting ELECTION_BUDGET's docstring to name ELECTION_SLACK exposed a SECOND false stated reason the reviewer had not found — ELECTION_SLACK 'absorbs store-clock skew and one missed refresh interval', where a missed refresh interval is LEASE_HEARTBEAT_INTERVAL = 15s, three times the 5s constant, and needs no absorbing anyway (a holder gets three chances inside one TTL and is supposed to lose the lease if it misses all three). Citing a constant is a commitment to its docstring being true. [Logic] (score 3.97)

Positioning thesis (operator, 2026-08-20): even with canonization never triggering, lambo beats RAG for WORKING SESSIONS — not on retrieval quality (near-equivalent; RAG may currently retrieve better given the embedding gap) but on everything around it: the unit is a typed decision-with-why authored at decision time, not an arbitrary chunk; there is a write side (dedup/merge, corrections linked to what they correct, causal lineage via record_action) where RAG is a read-only accumulating pile; it is a live coordination surface (soft locks, per-agent identity, blast warnings) which RAG has no concept of; and it fails loudly and measurably (ledger, stats, degrade warnings) where a stale index fails silently. Canonization is a month-scale concern; working sessions are day-scale. The honest cost: value is proportional to write discipline — RAG asks nothing of the author, lambo without a prompted protocol got zero agent usage — which is why J3 making derive free matters beyond latency.
